title: Boltor Prime
extract:
The Boltor Prime is the Prime variant of the  Boltor rifle, featuring higher damage, critical chance, critical multiplier, status chance, accuracy, fire rate, and slightly faster reload speed. 

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Puncture damage.
Bolts fired stick to their target, and will fling bodies on kill.
The body will damage targets in its path.
Corpses can be pinned to terrain.
Advantages over other Primary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Flung bodies help in dealing with crowds.
Low recoil.

Acquisition

This weapon can be sold for  7,500.

Vaultings
On February 9th, 2016, it was announced that Boltor Prime would enter the Prime Vault and be retired from the reward tables on February 16, 2016. Any preexisting components or fully-built weapons will remain as is.
Boltor Prime along with  Ankyros Prime,  Boar Prime,  Dakra Prime,  Mag Prime, and Rhino Prime were unvaulted on June 27, 2017 to August 1, 2017.
Boltor Prime, along with  Ankyros Prime,  Hikou Prime,  Scindo Prime,  Nyx Prime, and  Rhino Prime, were once again unvaulted on July 24, 2018 to September 25, 2018. It resurfaced again together with the same line-up from July 16th, 2019 to September 3rd, 2019.

Notes
The lack of  Slash damage means that the mods  Sawtooth Clip and  Fanged Fusillade will have no effect on this weapon.
The innate  polarity matches  Primed Cryo Rounds and Galvanized Aptitude.
Due to its above average status chance, users will often use  Rime Rounds instead of Cryo Rounds to make  Viral or  Magnetic damage, which requires a  polarity.

Incarnon Genesis

Upon completion of The Duviri Paradox and Angels of the Zariman, and unlocking The Steel Path, players can earn  Boltor Incarnon Genesis from The Circuit's Steel Path to place on their Boltor with the help of Cavalero in the Chrysalith. This Incarnon Genesis form grants it evolutions to a transformation and newfound strength.
Purchased from Cavalero for  120, complete with the resources used in its installation. This purchase can only be made once.

Installing the Boltor Incarnon Genesis requires 20  Pathos Clamps, 60  Rune Marrow, and 60  Silphsela.
When installed, the first Evolution tier is unlocked. Each challenge additionally grants 5,000 affinity to the weapon, affected by Affinity Boosters.

Overview
Incarnon Form is charged by filling the Incarnon Transmutation gauge that appears under the reticle by achieving weakpoint hits and then pressing the Alternate Fire button. 20 weakpoints hits will completely fill the gauge. A full gauge is not required to activate Incarnon Form.
Charges do not generate on the backpacks of most MOA variants, or vulnerability spots generated by  Sonar or  Detect Vulnerability in places other than actual weakpoints.
Weakpoints on corpses or Invulnerable targets do not build charges.
Individual Multishot bullets can build charges.
Mode switching is not instantaneous and has an animation equal to the weapon's reload speed.
Swapping to and from Incarnon Form will fully reload the normal form's magazine.
Instead of drawing ammunition from its reserves, the Boltor's Incarnon Form uses a separate "magazine" with each charge producing 8 rounds to a maximum of 160. Once all ammunition is expended, the Boltor reverts to its normal form.
Incarnon Form's magazine is not affected by mods.
Incarnon Form is not affected by Ammo Efficiency (such as  Energized Munitions).
Charges and Incarnon Form persists through all activities, such as holstering, bleedout, or being disarmed. However, charges and Incarnon Form are removed upon death.

Evolutions

Tips
The Boltor Prime has a knockback effect on kill that can be used instead of Punch Through so the mod slot can be used for something else.
The knockback works in tandem with Punch Through mods, making a Boltor Prime with  Shred or  Metal Auger quite effective when fired against lines of enemies as it both punches through them and knocks any killed enemies back into the line.

Trivia
Boltor Prime was released alongside  Rhino Prime and  Ankyros Prime.
Boltor Prime is the sixth primed Primary weapon ever released.
Compared to previous Prime weapons, the Boltor and the Boltor Prime have a much closer resemblance to each other.
A possible explanation is the manufacturing faction. The Boltor is a Tenno produced weapon, like, for example, the  Braton.
The Boltor Prime's gold parts can be recolored as of Update 15.13 (2015-02-05).
